name: handwriting-sheets
description: Custom tracing worksheets and blank practice paper as vector PDFs.

interface.longDescription:
Penline Handwriting Sheets makes printable handwriting worksheets for students, teachers and home practice. Turn letters, words, sentences or a name into a vector PDF with writing guides and space to copy independently.

Choose dotted outlines, light grey letters or outlines. Writing rows include a solid top line, a dashed midline, a solid baseline and descender space. Choose body heights of 0.5, 0.625, 0.75 or 1 inch on Letter or A4 paper, portrait or landscape. Print at 100% to preserve the selected size.

Name tracing worksheets alternate tracing and blank rows. Custom tracing worksheets wrap longer text at word boundaries, fill each tracing row with as many copies as fit when repetitions are omitted, or use one to four explicitly requested copies and include a blank copy row. Printable lined paper supports one to twenty pages with optional dashed midlines. The widget previews the first page and provides the PDF download.

Limits: print (manuscript) letters only, no cursive. The available proportional sans-serif font is adapted to the writing guides; it is not a specialist instructional alphabet. Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters are supported. Unsupported glyphs produce an error. Practice text is limited to 600 characters and names to 40 characters. Whitespace is normalized. A word or name too wide at the chosen size produces an error; reduce body height or repetitions, choose landscape, or shorten it.
defaultPrompt: Make a name tracing worksheet for Emma: 6 rows, Letter portrait, 0.5 inch body height, dotted outline.
Make letter tracing for A on Letter portrait, 0.5 inch body height, 2 repetitions per line, light grey.
Make 2 pages of printable lined paper, Letter portrait, 0.625 inch body height, with dashed midlines.

positive.prompt: Make a name tracing worksheet for Emma: 6 rows, Letter portrait, 0.5 inch body height, dotted outline.
positive.expected_behavior: Produces 1 PDF page(s) with 6 writing rows, including 3 tracing rows and 3 blank rows. Body height is 36 pt. Provides a vector PDF download and first-page preview.

positive.prompt: Make letter tracing for A on Letter portrait, 0.5 inch body height, 2 repetitions per line, light grey.
positive.expected_behavior: Produces 1 PDF page(s) with 2 writing rows, including 1 tracing rows and 1 blank rows. Body height is 36 pt. Provides a vector PDF download and first-page preview.

positive.prompt: Make handwriting practice sheets for The cat sat. on Letter portrait, 0.5 inch body height, outline tracing.
positive.expected_behavior: Produces 1 PDF page(s) with 2 writing rows, including 1 tracing rows and 1 blank rows. Body height is 36 pt. Provides a vector PDF download and first-page preview.

positive.prompt: Make 2 pages of printable lined paper, Letter portrait, 0.625 inch body height, with dashed midlines.
positive.expected_behavior: Produces 2 PDF page(s) with 12 writing rows, including 0 tracing rows and 12 blank rows. Body height is 45 pt. Provides a vector PDF download and first-page preview.

positive.prompt: Make a name tracing worksheet for Łukasz: 6 rows, A4 landscape, 0.5 inch body height, dotted tracing.
positive.expected_behavior: Produces 2 PDF page(s) with 6 writing rows, including 3 tracing rows and 3 blank rows. Body height is 36 pt. Provides a vector PDF download and first-page preview.

negative.prompt: Turn my name into cursive handwriting.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that cursive is not supported; does not present print letters as cursive.

negative.prompt: Make Arabic calligraphy tracing for مرحبا.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the unsupported-script limit; does not silently remove letters.

negative.prompt: Read the handwriting in a photo and grade the penmanship.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call a sheet generation tool; handwriting recognition and grading are outside scope.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: vector PDF tracing worksheets, name practice and blank lined paper with first-page preview.

pl-PL.subtitle: Arkusze pisania i liniatura
pl-PL.description: Drukowane arkusze do ćwiczenia liter, słów, zdań i imion oraz pusty papier z liniaturą w formacie PDF. Pismo drukowane, bez kursywy. Obsługa liter łacińskich, greckich i cyrylicy.

de-DE.subtitle: Schreibübungen als PDF
de-DE.description: Druckbare Schreibübungen für Buchstaben, Wörter, Sätze und Namen sowie leeres liniertes Papier als PDF. Druckschrift, keine Schreibschrift. Lateinische, griechische und kyrillische Buchstaben.

es-ES.subtitle: Trazado y papel pautado
es-ES.description: Hojas imprimibles para practicar letras, palabras, frases y nombres, y papel pautado en PDF. Letras de imprenta, sin cursiva. Admite letras latinas, griegas y cirílicas.

fr-FR.subtitle: Écriture et papier ligné
fr-FR.description: Fiches imprimables pour tracer des lettres, mots, phrases et prénoms, et papier ligné en PDF. Lettres d’imprimerie, sans cursive. Lettres latines, grecques et cyrilliques.

ja-JP.subtitle: なぞり書き・罫線用紙PDF
ja-JP.description: 文字、単語、文、名前のなぞり書き練習と空白の罫線用紙をPDFで作成します。活字体のみで、筆記体は非対応。ラテン文字、ギリシャ文字、キリル文字に対応。

pt-BR.subtitle: Treino de escrita em PDF
pt-BR.description: Folhas para praticar letras, palavras, frases e nomes, além de papel pautado em PDF. Letras de forma, sem cursiva. Aceita letras latinas, gregas e cirílicas.
